description.value: Households who prioritize lowest effective monthly cost and respond strongly to promotional pricing and bundle offers.

demographic_signals.value: High sensitivity to first-year promotions and post-promo bill shock
Likely multi-provider consideration set (cable, fiber, fixed wireless)

description.value: Addresses recently reached by carrier expansions or federal/state-funded buildouts, often underserviced historically and motivated by availability and reliability.

demographic_signals.value: Higher conversion potential where fiber is newly available

description.value: Small businesses and remote workers that value symmetrical speeds, reliable SLA-like service, and local technical support.

demographic_signals.value: Preference for symmetric speeds and low downtime; willing to pay a premium for reliability

pain_statement.value: Households face lower advertised promo rates that jump materially after 12 months, causing bill shock.

desired_outcome.value: Transparent, predictable pricing with a clear first-year and post-promo price communicated up front.

pain_statement.value: Rural or newly served addresses are uncertain about true local availability and installation timelines.

desired_outcome.value: Clear coverage maps, realistic install windows, and prioritized scheduling for newly lit neighborhoods.

pain_statement.value: Bundled mobile+home discounts from national carriers make switching less attractive despite local service benefits.

desired_outcome.value: Competitive effective monthly pricing through targeted promotions and partnership discounts that close the bundle gap.

headline.value: Local fiber with transparent pricing, symmetric speeds, and responsive hometown support.

supporting_points.value: Predictable pricing with clear post-promo expectations to avoid bill shock.
Symmetric gigabit-class fiber where available, prioritized for newly served neighborhoods.
Local, U.S.-based technicians and faster issue resolution versus national call centers.

no_bundle_gap_response.value: Offer targeted bill credits or partner discounts for customers switching from bundled national providers and create a simple 'bring-your-phone' credit option to narrow effective monthly cost differences.

low_brand_recognition_response.value: Invest early in visible local sponsorships, referral bonuses, and targeted address-level direct mail highlighting local install success stories to build trust quickly.

positioning_statement.value: Wire3 is the local fiber-first alternative to national bundled providers: delivering symmetric speeds, transparent billing, and faster local service for Ocala neighborhoods newly reached by fiber.

differentiators.value: Local-first operations: local technicians and neighborhood-focused install scheduling.
Transparent pricing with upfront post-promo disclosures to reduce bill shock.
Fiber symmetric speeds and no data caps where deployed.

supporting_message.value: Show full-year effective pricing, post-promo rates, and no hidden fees so customers can compare apples-to-apples with national promos.
Local technicians, faster onsite response, and neighborhood install focus to minimize downtime and support friction.
Promote symmetric upload/download speeds and no data caps as a value differentiator for remote work and small business needs.

rationale.value: High intent searches for availability can be captured with low-cost neighborhood landing pages; supports transparency on coverage and pricing.
Address-targeted promos (first-year price messaging) convert cost-sensitive households and drive initial trial signups.
Sponsoring local events and civic groups raises awareness for a low-recognition regional brand and builds trust quickly.

channels.channel_name: Partnerships with local employers / anchor businesses

rationale.value: Partnership discounts and co-marketing with local employers help close the bundle gap and reach small-business/home-office users.
Referral bonuses amplify word-of-mouth in newly served neighborhoods at low cost and address low brand recognition.

activities.value: Confirm Wire3 advertised speeds, pricing, and exact coverage per address (resolve UNK-1).
Publish address-level landing pages and local FAQ about installations and pricing.
Begin targeted paid search for newly lit neighborhoods.

launch_phases.exit_criteria: Verified coverage/pricing for target neighborhoods and 50+ signups on waitlist/interest forms.

activities.value: Execute promo offers (clear 12-month promo + post-promo disclosure) and local install blitz.
Deploy referral incentives and employer partnership discounts.

launch_phases.exit_criteria: Achieve initial subscription target and maintain installation SLA for >80% installs in promised window.

activities.value: Expand community sponsorships, optimize paid channels, and roll out loyalty/price-lock options for multi-year retention.
Monitor competitor bundle moves and adjust targeted credits/offers to protect retention.

launch_phases.exit_criteria: Sustained month-over-month net adds and churn below target thresholds.

success_metrics.name: New subscribers (12 months)
success_metrics.definition: Total new active paying subscribers acquired in first 12 months after launch in targeted neighborhoods.

success_metrics.name: Churn rate (annualized)
success_metrics.definition: Percent of customers who cancel service within 12 months.

success_metrics.name: First-year promo conversion to full-price retention
success_metrics.definition: Share of customers who remain active 3 months after promo expiration.

success_metrics.name: Address-level activation rate
success_metrics.definition: Percent of addresses that complete installation within promised SLA after being advertised as serviceable.

statement.value: National carriers use bundled mobile+home discounts to retain customers and undercut regional pricing.

mitigation.value: Targeted partnership discounts, competitive effective-rate offers, and employer-based deals to narrow bundle gap.

statement.value: Customer dissatisfaction from promotional roll-off and perceived hidden costs.

mitigation.value: Publish clear blended-12mo pricing, provide grace offers at promo end, and emphasize total cost of ownership vs. competitors.

statement.value: Delays in buildout or installation logistics slow activation and damage local reputation.

mitigation.value: Set realistic install windows, over-communicate status to customers, and reserve install crews for prioritized neighborhoods.

follow_up_research_questions.question: Confirm Wire3's actual advertised speeds, published pricing (promo and post-promo), equipment fees, and address-level coverage in Ocala.
follow_up_research_questions.rationale: The evidence set contains no records referencing Wire3; key inputs (speeds, pricing, coverage) must be validated before launching offers or publishing address-level availability.
